factor_definitions.composite: 👑 DOE 複合動能冠軍 (Composite Score: (85% Raw + 15% Res) × FIP × Convexity)
factor_definitions.blend_mom: ⚖️ 混合動能基底 (Blend Momentum: 85% Raw + 15% Residual Alpha)
factor_definitions.mom_12m: 🚀 12個月長線動能 (12M Momentum, 經典中長週期效應)
factor_definitions.mom_6m: ⏳ 6個月中長線動能 (6M Momentum, 趨勢延續中樞)
factor_definitions.mom_3m: ⚡ 3個月中線動能 (3M Momentum, 季線主升波段)
factor_definitions.mom_1m: ⏱️ 1個月短線動能 (1M Momentum, 月度輪動爆發力)
factor_definitions.mom_2w: 🏃 2週超短衝刺動能 (2W Momentum, 短線急攻力道)
factor_definitions.res_mom: ⚡ 純殘差動能 (Residual Alpha: 剝離 SPY Beta 後的真實個股 Alpha)
factor_definitions.fip: 🐸 FIP 溫水煮青蛙連續性 (Frog-in-the-Pan: 252日漲跌天數連續比率)
factor_definitions.convexity: 📐 60D 非對稱波動凸性比 (Convexity: 上行爆發波動 / 下行收斂波動)
factor_definitions.er_60: 🌊 Kaufman 60D 分形趨勢效率比 (Efficiency Ratio: 淨位移 / 總波動路徑)
factor_definitions.prox_52w: 🎯 52週新高接近度 (52W High Proximity: 股價 / 252日最高價)
factor_definitions.bias_ma60: 📏 60MA 季線乖離率 (Price / 60MA - 1, 趨勢加速偏離)
factor_definitions.zscore_20d: 🎚️ 20日價格 Z-Score ((Price - 20MA) / Std20, 均值回歸與極端偏離)
factor_definitions.vcp_score: 🌪️ VCP 波動收縮緊湊度 (Minervini VCP: 振幅收縮度 + 5D量縮枯竭 + 樞紐接近度)
factor_definitions.chip_score: 💎 籌碼沉澱與吸籌 (Chip Concentration: 上下漲跌量能吸收比 + 20D CMF 機構吸籌)
